## ONE_DRIVE_LIST_SITE_LISTS
Tool to list all lists under a specific SharePoint site. Use when you need to enumerate lists within a known site. Returns only Microsoft Graph-supported lists — internal/system lists are excluded, so results may be a strict subset of all site lists (e.g., 13 returned where 108 exist). Results are in the `data.value` array. IMPORTANT: Only works with organizational Microsoft 365 accounts (Azure AD/Entra ID). NOT supported for personal Microsoft accounts (MSA/Outlook.com/Hotmail). Personal OneDrive users cannot access SharePoint sites through this endpoint.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListSiteListsRequest",
  "required": [
    "site_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "top": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Top",
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "The maximum number of items to return.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Top Items",
      "human_parameter_description": "Limit how many lists are returned. Enter the maximum number of results you want."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        "columns,items"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of relationships to expand in the response. Example: columns,items",
      "human_parameter_name": "Expand Relationships",
      "human_parameter_description": "Include related details for each list, such as columns or items. Provide a comma-separated list like columns,items."
    },
    "filter": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Filter",
      "examples": [
        "startswith(name,'Doc')"
      ],
      "description": "OData filter expression. Example: startswith(name,'Doc')",
      "human_parameter_name": "Filter Query",
      "human_parameter_description": "Filter the lists you get back, for example by name. Use a simple expression like startswith(name,'Doc') to narrow the results."
    },
    "select": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Select",
      "examples": [
        "id,name,list"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of properties to include in the response. Example: id,name,list",
      "human_parameter_name": "Select Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which properties to return for each list so the response is shorter. Provide a comma-separated list like id,name,list."
    },
    "orderby": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Orderby",
      "examples": [
        "name asc"
      ],
      "description": "OData order by expression. Example: name asc",
      "human_parameter_name": "Order By",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose how to sort the results, such as by name ascending. Example: name asc."
    },
    "site_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Site Id",
      "examples": [
        "contoso.sharepoint.com,2C712604-1370-44E7-A1F5-426573FDA80A,2D4B0860-D7DE-419B-88E6-5866AF240000"
      ],
      "description": "SharePoint site ID in the required composite format: 'hostname,site-collection-id,web-id' (e.g., 'contoso.sharepoint.com,2C712604-1370-44E7-A1F5-426573FDA80A,2D4B0860-D7DE-419B-88E6-5866AF240000'). Must contain exactly two commas separating three parts: (1) SharePoint hostname, (2) site collection GUID, (3) web GUID. Only works with organizational Microsoft 365 accounts.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Site ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the SharePoint site ID in the required format: hostname,site-collection-id,web-id. Example: contoso.sharepoint.com,2C712604-1370-44E7-A1F5-426573FDA80A,2D4B0860-D7DE-419B-88E6-5866AF240000. You can get this from Microsoft Graph API. NOTE: Requires Microsoft 365 organizational account."
    }
  }
}
```

## ONE_DRIVE_LIST_SITE_SUBSITES
Tool to list all subsites of a SharePoint site. Use when you need to retrieve a collection of subsites for a given parent site. IMPORTANT: This action only works with organizational Microsoft 365 accounts (Azure AD/Entra ID accounts). It is NOT supported for personal Microsoft accounts (MSA/Outlook.com/Hotmail accounts). Personal OneDrive users cannot access SharePoint sites through this endpoint. An empty `value` array in the response means the site has no subsites, not a failure.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListSiteSubsitesRequest",
  "required": [
    "site_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "top": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Top",
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "The maximum number of items to return.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Top Items",
      "human_parameter_description": "Limit how many subsites are returned. Enter the maximum number of results you want."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        "drive"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of relationships to expand in the response.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Expand Relationships",
      "human_parameter_description": "Include related details for each subsite, such as drive or lists. Provide a comma-separated list of relationships to expand."
    },
    "filter": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Filter",
      "examples": [
        "startswith(name,'Project')"
      ],
      "description": "OData filter expression. Example: startswith(name,'Project')",
      "human_parameter_name": "Filter Query",
      "human_parameter_description": "Filter the subsites you get back, for example by name. Use a simple expression like startswith(name,'Project') to narrow the results."
    },
    "select": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Select",
      "examples": [
        "id,name,webUrl"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of properties to include in the response. Example: id,name,webUrl",
      "human_parameter_name": "Select Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which properties to return for each subsite to keep results concise. Provide a comma-separated list like id,name,webUrl."
    },
    "orderby": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Orderby",
      "examples": [
        "name asc",
        "createdDateTime desc"
      ],
      "description": "OData order by expression. Example: name asc, createdDateTime desc",
      "human_parameter_name": "Order By",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose how to sort the results, such as by name ascending or creation date. Example: name asc."
    },
    "site_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Site Id",
      "examples": [
        "contoso.sharepoint.com,da60e844-ba1d-49bc-b4d4-d5e36bae9019,712a596e-90a1-49e3-9b48-bfa80bee8740"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the SharePoint site for which to list subsites. Must be the full composite Graph ID in the format `hostname,siteCollectionId,siteId`; partial or malformed IDs may silently return empty results rather than an error.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Site ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the SharePoint site whose subsites you want to list. Paste the site's ID in the same format as the example, which you can get from a site lookup or your SharePoint admin center."
    }
  }
}
```

## ONE_DRIVE_LIST_SUBSCRIPTIONS
Tool to list the current subscriptions for the authenticated user or app. Use this to retrieve details of existing webhook subscriptions. Results may span multiple drives and resources; filter client-side by resource URL or type to narrow to a specific scope. An empty `value` array means no subscriptions exist, not a failed call.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListSubscriptionsRequest",
  "properties": {}
}
```

## ONE_DRIVE_MOVE_ITEM
Tool to move a file or folder to a new parent folder in OneDrive. Use when you need to reorganize your files or folders by changing their location. You can optionally rename the item during the move. If a file with the same name exists at the destination, the API returns `nameAlreadyExists`; use the `name` parameter to provide a unique name or resolve the conflict beforehand.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "MoveItemRequest",
  "required": [
    "itemId",
    "parentReference"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "new-document.docx"
      ],
      "description": "The new name for the DriveItem. If not provided, the item retains its original name. Must not contain illegal filename characters; invalid characters cause an `invalidRequest` error.",
      "human_parameter_name": "New Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter a new name if you want to rename the item during the move; leave empty to keep the current name."
    },
    "itemId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Item Id",
      "examples": [
        "01BYE5RZZ272Y2AM3L22L22Z2Y2Y2Y2Y2Y"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the file or folder (DriveItem) to be moved.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Item ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the file or folder you want to move. You can grab this from the item's link or from a previous list or search."
    },
    "siteId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Site Id",
      "examples": [
        "contoso.sharepoint.com,2C712604-132D-4AC7-A58A-9919A6B0A862,D8A48A4A-274E-4494-8B2A-40E71A6E1D8A"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the site if the item is in a SharePoint site. Mutually exclusive with drive_id, group_id, and user_id.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Site ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "If the item is in a SharePoint site, enter that site's ID so we can find the item there."
    },
    "userId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "024d423a-35ef-450e-9317-5669101788f0"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the user if accessing another user's drive. Mutually exclusive with drive_id, group_id, and site_id.",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Use this when moving items in another person's OneDrive. Enter their user ID or email; leave blank to use your own."
    },
    "driveId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Drive Id",
      "examples": [
        "b!C1b2A3d4E5f6G7h8I9j0K1l2M3n4O5p6"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Drive that contains the item. If not specified, it defaults to the user's personal drive (`/me/drive`).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Drive ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "If the item is in a specific OneDrive or SharePoint drive, provide its Drive ID; leave empty to use your default drive."
    },
    "groupId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group Id",
      "examples": [
        "024d423a-35ef-450e-9317-5669101788f0"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the group if the item is in a group drive. Mutually exclusive with drive_id, site_id, and user_id.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Group ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "If the item lives in a Microsoft 365 group drive, enter that group's ID so we know where to look."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "examples": [
        "Moved project proposal document."
      ],
      "description": "The new description for the drive item. If not provided, the item's description is not changed.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Description",
      "human_parameter_description": "A short summary or notes about the item to help others understand it. Leave blank to keep the current description."
    },
    "parentReference": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Parent Reference",
      "examples": [
        {
          "id": "01BYE5RZZ272Y2AM3L22L22Z2Y2Y2Y2Y2Y"
        },
        {
          "id": "01BYE5RZZ272Y2AM3L22L22Z2Y2Y2Y2Y2Y",
          "driveId": "b!C1b2A3d4E5f6G7h8I9j0K1l2M3n4O5p6"
        }
      ],
      "required": [
        "id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "examples": [
            "01BYE5RZZ272Y2AM3L22L22Z2Y2Y2Y2Y2Y"
          ],
          "description": "The unique identifier (ID) of the destination parent folder. This must be the folder's unique ID string (e.g., '01BYE5RZZ272Y2AM3L22L22Z2Y2Y2Y2Y2Y'), not the folder's display name. You can obtain the folder ID by listing folder contents or searching for items."
        },
        "driveId": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Drive Id",
          "examples": [
            "b!C1b2A3d4E5f6G7h8I9j0K1l2M3n4O5p6"
          ],
          "description": "The unique identifier of the Drive containing the destination folder. Typically not needed as the API assumes the same drive. Note: The move operation does not support moving items between different drives - use the copy operation for cross-drive transfers."
        }
      },
      "description": "An object specifying the destination folder. Must be provided as an object/dictionary with an 'id' field containing the folder's unique identifier. Format: {\"id\": \"<folder-id>\", \"driveId\": \"<drive-id>\"} (driveId is optional). Example: {\"id\": \"01BYE5RZZ272Y2AM3L22L22Z2Y2Y2Y2Y2Y\"}. Note: Folder names are not accepted - use the folder's unique ID obtained from listing or searching items.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "human_parameter_description": "The destination folder for the item. Must be an object with the folder's unique ID, e.g., {\"id\": \"folder-id-here\"}. The ID can be obtained by listing folder contents or searching for items. Folder names (display names) are not accepted."
    }
  }
}
```

## ONE_DRIVE_ONEDRIVE_CREATE_FOLDER
Creates a new folder in the user's OneDrive, automatically renaming on conflict, optionally within a specified parent_folder (by ID or full path from root) which, if not the root, must exist and be accessible.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "description": "The desired name for the new folder (also accepts 'folder_name' as an alias). If a folder with this name already exists in the specified parent_folder, the new folder will be automatically renamed (e.g., 'New Folder' might become 'New Folder 1'). Examples: ['Annual Reports', 'Client Meeting Notes']",
      "human_parameter_name": "Folder Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "The name you want to give the new folder. If that name already exists in the chosen location, we'll add a number to make it unique."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "The user's ID, email, or 'me'. Defaults to 'me' (authenticated user). Required for S2S (app-only) auth.",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The email address or identifier of the OneDrive account to use. Enter 'me' to use your own account."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "description": "Optional description for the folder. Provides a user-visible description of the folder. Examples: ['Project documents for Q1 2024', 'Meeting notes archive']",
      "human_parameter_name": "Description",
      "human_parameter_description": "An optional description or summary for the folder to help others understand its purpose."
    },
    "parent_folder": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent Folder",
      "default": "/",
      "description": "ID or full path of the parent folder for the new folder. Paths must start from the root (e.g., '/Documents/Reports'). If an ID is provided, it refers to an existing folder's unique ID. Examples: ['/Projects/Alpha', 'folder_id_12345ABC', '/']",
      "human_parameter_name": "Parent Folder",
      "human_parameter_description": "Where you want to create the new folder. Provide a full path from the root (like '/Documents/Reports'), a specific folder ID, or use '/' for the root."
    }
  }
}
```

## ONE_DRIVE_ONEDRIVE_CREATE_TEXT_FILE
Creates a new plain-text file with specified content in the authenticated user's personal OneDrive, using either the folder's unique ID or its absolute path relative to the user's OneDrive root (paths are automatically resolved to IDs); note that OneDrive may rename or create a new version if the filename already exists. All files are written as plain text regardless of extension — specifying .docx or .xlsx does not produce a true Office document. This action only works with the user's personal OneDrive (/me/drive) and does not support SharePoint document libraries or shared drives.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateTextFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "name",
    "content"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Annual Report 2023.txt",
        "Meeting Notes.md",
        "script.sh"
      ],
      "description": "The desired name for the new text file, including its extension (e.g., 'report.txt', 'notes.log'). Also accepts 'file_name' as an alias.",
      "human_parameter_name": "File Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "The exact name you want for the new text file, including the extension (e.g., 'notes.txt'). This is how it will appear in OneDrive."
    },
    "folder": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Folder",
      "default": "/",
      "examples": [
        "/Documents/Projects",
        "MyFolder",
        "01NKDM7HMOJTVYMDOSXFDK2QJDXCDI3WUK"
      ],
      "description": "The folder within the user's personal OneDrive where the new text file will be created. Use '/' for root, a path like '/Documents/Projects' (relative to OneDrive root), a folder name like 'MyFolder' (treated as '/MyFolder'), or a valid folder ID. Note: Paths are resolved against the user's personal OneDrive (/me/drive/root) only and cannot target SharePoint document libraries or shared drives.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Folder",
      "human_parameter_description": "The folder in your personal OneDrive where you want to create the new file. You can enter a path like '/Documents/Projects' (relative to your OneDrive root), a folder name like 'MyFolder', or a folder ID; use '/' for your OneDrive root. Note: This only works with your personal OneDrive, not SharePoint sites."
    },
    "content": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content",
      "examples": [
        "This is the content of the new text file.",
        "TODO: Finalize the project proposal by EOD."
      ],
      "description": "The plain text content to be written into the new file. For very large text bodies, the request may fail or truncate; split large content across multiple files if needed.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Content",
      "human_parameter_description": "The text to store in the file. Paste or type the content exactly as you want it saved."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "user_principal_name_or_id"
      ],
      "description": "The user's ID or the literal 'me' to represent the currently authenticated user.",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The email address or ID of the OneDrive user whose drive you want to use. Enter 'me' to use your own OneDrive."
    },
    "conflict_behavior": {
      "enum": [
        "fail",
        "replace",
        "rename"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Conflict Behavior",
      "default": "fail",
      "examples": [
        "fail",
        "replace",
        "rename"
      ],
      "description": "How to handle conflicts when a file with the same name already exists. 'fail' (default) returns an error if the file exists, 'replace' overwrites the existing file, 'rename' creates a new file with an incremented name (e.g., 'file 1.txt').",
      "human_parameter_name": "Conflict Behavior",
      "human_parameter_description": "What to do if a file with this name already exists: 'fail' will show an error, 'replace' will overwrite the existing file, or 'rename' will create a new file with a number added to the name."
    }
  }
}
```

## ONE_DRIVE_ONEDRIVE_FIND_FILE
Non-recursively finds an item (file or folder) in a specified OneDrive folder; if `folder` is provided as a path, it must actually exist. Results in large folders may be paginated via `@odata.nextLink`; iterate all pages to avoid missing files. For searches where the subfolder is unknown, use ONE_DRIVE_SEARCH_ITEMS instead.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "FindItemRequest",
  "required": [
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "QuarterlyReport.docx",
        "Project Alpha"
      ],
      "description": "The exact name of the file or folder to find within the specified `folder`. Multiple items may match common names; use `include_metadata=true` and disambiguate by path, size, or last-modified timestamp.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Item Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "The exact file or folder name you're trying to find inside the selected folder."
    },
    "folder": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Folder",
      "default": "/",
      "examples": [
        "/Documents/Projects",
        "folder_id_example"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier (ID) or absolute path of the OneDrive folder for the search. For the root folder, use '/'. Paths must start with '/'. A non-existent folder silently returns no results rather than an error.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Folder",
      "human_parameter_description": "The folder where you want to look for the item. Enter a full path like '/Documents/Projects' or a folder ID; use '/' for the root."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "user_guid_example",
        "me"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the user (e.g., a GUID) or the alias 'me' to represent the currently authenticated user. This determines whose OneDrive will be accessed.",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The email address or ID of the OneDrive account you want to search. Use 'me' to search your own OneDrive."
    },
    "include_metadata": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Metadata",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If set to true, the response will include the complete metadata for each found item. If false (default), only essential properties like id, name, and webUrl are returned.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Include Metadata",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether to include full details for each matching item. Turn on for rich info; leave off for a simple, faster list."
    }
  }
}
```

## ONE_DRIVE_ONEDRIVE_FIND_FOLDER
Finds folders by name within an accessible parent folder in OneDrive, or lists all its direct child folders if no name is specified. Search is non-recursive: only immediate children of `folder` are checked, not deeper hierarchy levels.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "FindFolderRequest",
  "properties": {
    "top": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Top",
      "maximum": 999,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        50,
        200
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of items to return in a single request. When specified, auto-pagination is disabled and only one page is returned. Use with skip_token to manually paginate through results.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Top",
      "human_parameter_description": "Limit the number of items returned (1-999). When set, only one page is returned - use skip_token for next pages."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Annual Reports",
        "Meeting Notes"
      ],
      "description": "Exact name of the folder to find. If omitted, all direct child folders of the parent `folder` are returned.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Folder Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "The exact name of the folder you want to find under the parent folder. Leave this blank to list all immediate subfolders instead."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        "thumbnails",
        "children"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of relationships to expand in the response (e.g., 'thumbnails', 'children'). See Microsoft Graph API documentation for supported expand properties.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Expand",
      "human_parameter_description": "Expand related resources in the response (e.g., 'thumbnails' to include thumbnail data)."
    },
    "folder": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Folder",
      "default": "/",
      "examples": [
        "/Documents/Projects",
        "folder_id_example"
      ],
      "description": "Path (e.g., '/My Files/Work', '/' for root) or unique ID of the parent folder where child folders are searched.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Folder",
      "human_parameter_description": "The parent folder where you want to look for subfolders. Enter a path like '/Documents/Projects', use '/' for the root, or paste a specific folder ID."
    },
    "select": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Select",
      "examples": [
        [
          "id",
          "name",
          "webUrl",
          "size",
          "lastModifiedDateTime"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of properties to include in the response (e.g., ['id', 'name', 'size']). ## ONE_DRIVE_ONEDRIVE_LIST_ITEMS
```
Retrieves all files and folders as `driveItem` resources from the root of a specified user's OneDrive, automatically handling pagination. Non-recursive: returns only root-level items; subfolder contents require separate calls. Results may include `remoteItem` pointers (shared items from other drives) — use `remoteItem.driveId` and `remoteItem.id` for those in downstream calls. Distinguish files from folders by presence of `file` or `folder` property. Always use `id` values returned by this tool directly; never construct item IDs manually. Items may be absent from results due to permission restrictions, not drive absence.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListItemsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "top": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Top",
      "default": 50,
      "examples": [
        "20",
        "100",
        "999"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum items per API request, setting the batch size; the action automatically handles pagination to fetch all items. The Microsoft Graph API may limit this (e.g., to 999).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Top Items",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many items to retrieve per request. Higher numbers reduce the number of requests, but the service may limit the maximum."
    },
    "select": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Select",
      "default": [],
      "examples": [
        "[\"id\", \"name\", \"webUrl\"]",
        "[\"name\", \"size\", \"lastModifiedDateTime\", \"fileSystemInfo\"]"
      ],
      "description": "Specifies `driveItem` properties to return. If omitted or empty, default properties are returned. Refer to Microsoft Graph API documentation for a complete list of `driveItem` properties.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Select Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which details to include for each item (for example: name, size, or web link). Leave blank to use the default set."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com",
        "12345678-90ab-cdef-1234-567890abcdef"
      ],
      "description": "User's unique identifier (e.g., 'user@example.com', object ID) or 'me' for the authenticated user's OneDrive.",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The email address or identifier of the user whose OneDrive you want to browse. Use 'me' to access your own files."
    }
  }
}
```

## ONE_DRIVE_ONEDRIVE_UPLOAD_FILE
Uploads a file to a specified OneDrive folder, automatically creating the destination folder if it doesn't exist, renaming on conflict, and supporting large files via chunking.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UploadFileRequest",
  "required": [
    "file"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "file": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileUploadable",
      "required": [
        "name",
        "mimetype",
        "s3key"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "examples": [
            "document.pdf",
            "image.jpg",
            "report.docx"
          ],
          "description": "The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service"
        },
        "s3key": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "S3Key",
          "examples": [
            "47563/gmail/GET_ATTACHMENT/response/12345"
          ],
          "description": "The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service."
        },
        "mimetype": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Mimetype",
          "examples": [
            "application/pdf",
            "image/jpeg",
            "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document"
          ],
          "description": "The MIME type of the file"
        }
      },
      "description": "The file to be uploaded, including its name and access to its binary content.",
      "file_uploadable": true,
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "human_parameter_name": "File",

    },
    "folder": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Folder",
      "default": "/",
      "examples": [
        "/Documents/Projects",
        "folder_id_example"
      ],
      "description": "Destination folder path from root (e.g., '/Documents/Reports') or a unique folder ID. If the folder path doesn't exist, it will be created automatically (including any intermediate folders in the path).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Folder",
      "human_parameter_description": "The destination folder where you want the file to go. Enter a path like '/Documents/Reports' or a folder ID; use '/' for the root folder. If the folder doesn't exist, it will be created automatically."
    },
    "site_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Site Id",
      "examples": [
        "contoso.sharepoint.com,024d491a-4d09-4194-ae1f-7413535507dc,024d491a-4d09-4194-ae1f-7413535507dc"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the SharePoint site to upload to. If provided, uses /sites/{siteId}/drive. Mutually exclusive with drive_id.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Site ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique identifier of a SharePoint site to upload to. Leave empty to use personal OneDrive."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "testuser@contoso.com",
        "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
      ],
      "description": "User ID (e.g., user_principal_name, unique GUID) or 'me' for the authenticated user, determining the target OneDrive.",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The email address or identifier of the user whose OneDrive you want to upload to. Use 'me' to upload to your own OneDrive."
    },
    "drive_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Drive Id",
      "examples": [
        "b!C3NkF4b2GU2msLpLqgZ4oYd_S4P0S6_FhG0bS-WpTkYwGVc_FmBYSZ7d0x_ZJpG-"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the drive to upload to. If not provided, uses the default drive of the user_id. Mutually exclusive with site_id.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Drive ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique identifier of a specific drive to upload to. Leave empty to use the default drive."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "examples": [
        "Project proposal for Q1 2024"
      ],
      "description": "A user-visible description of the file. Only supported on OneDrive Personal.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Description",
      "human_parameter_description": "An optional description for the file. This only works with personal OneDrive accounts."
    },
    "defer_commit": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Defer Commit",
      "description": "If true, the final file creation is deferred until an explicit completion request is made. Useful for large files where you want to control when the upload is finalized.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Defer Commit",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set to true if you want to manually complete the upload later. This is useful for very large files."
    },
    "if_match_etag": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "If Match Etag",
      "examples": [
        "aQzlGRDlBMjdBRDQ5RUVCOTE3LjA"
      ],
      "description": "An ETag value to prevent lost updates. If provided, the upload will only proceed if the folder/parent's ETag matches this value. Returns 412 error if it doesn't match.",
      "human_parameter_name": "If-Match ETag",
      "human_parameter_description": "An ETag value for optimistic concurrency control. The upload will only proceed if this matches the current state."
    },
    "file_system_info": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileSystemInfo",
      "properties": {
        "createdDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Created Date Time",
          "format": "date-time",
          "examples": [
            "2023-01-15T10:30:00Z"
          ],
          "description": "The UTC date and time the file was created on a client. ISO 8601 format."
        },
        "lastAccessedDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Last Accessed Date Time",
          "format": "date-time",
          "examples": [
            "2023-01-21T08:00:00Z"
          ],
          "description": "The UTC date and time the file was last accessed. ISO 8601 format."
        },
        "lastModifiedDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Last Modified Date Time",
          "format": "date-time",
          "examples": [
            "2023-01-20T15:45:00Z"
          ],
          "description": "The UTC date and time the file was last modified on a client. ISO 8601 format."
        }
      },
      "description": "File system information on client.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "human_parameter_name": "File System Info",
      "human_parameter_description": "Optional file timestamps (created, modified, accessed dates). These preserve the original file dates."
    },
    "conflict_behavior": {
      "enum": [
        "rename",
        "fail",
        "replace"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Conflict Behavior",
      "default": "rename",
      "examples": [
        "rename",
        "fail",
        "replace"
      ],
      "description": "How to handle file name conflicts. 'rename' automatically renames the file if it exists (default), 'fail' returns an error, 'replace' overwrites the existing file. When renamed, the actual filename in the response may differ (e.g., suffixed with a number); use the response `id` or `webUrl` for follow-up operations.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Conflict Behavior",
      "human_parameter_description": "What to do if a file with the same name already exists. Choose 'rename' to create a new file with a number suffix, 'fail' to get an error, or 'replace' to overwrite the existing file."
    }
  }
}
```

## ONE_DRIVE_PREVIEW_DRIVE_ITEM
Generates or retrieves a short-lived, permission-bound embeddable URL for a preview of a specific item. URLs expire and must be regenerated per session — do not cache. Use when you need to display a temporary preview of a file.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PreviewDriveItemRequest",
  "required": [
    "item_id"
  ],
  "properties": {

          "type": "string"

        "1",
        "page1"

      "description": "Optional. Page number of document to start at, if applicable. Specified as string for future use cases around file types such as ZIP.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page Number",
      "human_parameter_description": "Start the preview on a specific page of the document. Enter a page number (like 1) or a label if the file uses named pages."
    },
    "zoom": {

        0.5,
        1
      ],
      "description": "Optional. Zoom level to start at, if applicable.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Zoom Level",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set the initial zoom level for the preview. Use 1.0 for 100%, 0.5 for 50%, 2.0 for 200%, etc."
    },
    "item_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Item Id",
      "examples": [
        "01BYE56RBCN4TCN3ORBZZ3S22LMR4LKL2A"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the DriveItem.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Item ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide the ID of the file you want to preview so we can generate a preview link. You can copy this from the file's details, URL, or a previous list/search step."
    },
    "site_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Site Id",
      "examples": [
        "contoso.sharepoint.com,2C712CB0-1531-4134-855A-67A093E71074,5A503C24-A59A-407C-BD5A-D392B8F7F000"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Site. Provide if the item is in a SharePoint site.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Site ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "If the file is stored in a SharePoint site, enter that site's ID so we search that site's drive. Skip if the item is in OneDrive."
    },

      "human_parameter_description": "If the file is in a specific drive (like a shared drive), enter that drive's ID so we look in the right place. Leave blank to use your own drive by default."
    },
    "group_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group Id",
      "examples": [

      ],
```

## ONE_DRIVE_RESTORE_DRIVE_ITEM
Tool to restore a deleted OneDrive driveItem (file or folder) from the recycle bin. Use when you need to recover a deleted item to its original location or to a specified parent folder, optionally renaming it during restoration. IMPORTANT LIMITATION: This API is ONLY available for OneDrive Personal accounts. It does NOT work with OneDrive for Business or SharePoint. For Business/SharePoint accounts, use the SharePoint REST API endpoints (/_api/web/recyclebin) instead.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RestoreDriveItemRequest",
  "required": [
    "item_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "restored-document.docx"
      ],
      "description": "(Optional) The new name for the restored item. If not provided, the item will be restored with its original name. This is useful if you want to rename the item during the restore process or if an item with the same name already exists in the destination.",
      "human_parameter_name": "New Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "Optional: Enter a new name for the restored item. Leave empty to keep the original name."
    },
    "item_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Item Id",
      "examples": [
        "01NKDM7HMOJTVYMDOSXFDK2QJDXCDI3WUK"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the deleted DriveItem (file or folder) to restore. This item must currently be in the OneDrive recycle bin. The ID can be obtained from deleted items listing or from the item before deletion.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Item ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the deleted file or folder you want to restore from the recycle bin. Use the ID from when the item was deleted or from a deleted items listing."
    },
    "drive_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Drive Id",
      "examples": [
        "b!C3NkF4b2GU2msLpLqgZ4oYd_S4P0S6_FhG0bS-WpTkYwGVc_FmBYSZ7d0x_ZJpG-"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Drive containing the deleted item. Required when using application authentication. If not provided with delegated authentication, uses the authenticated user's default drive.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Drive ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique identifier of the drive containing the deleted item. Required for application authentication or when accessing items in a specific drive."
    },
    "parent_reference_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent Reference Id",
      "examples": [
        "01BYE5RZZ272Y2AM3L22L22Z2Y2Y2Y2Y2Y"
      ],
      "description": "(Optional) The unique identifier of the parent folder where the item should be restored. If not provided, the item will be restored to its original parent location. This is useful when you want to restore the item to a different folder than where it was originally located.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Parent Reference ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Optional: The ID of the folder where you want to restore the item. Leave empty to restore to the original location."
    }
  }
}
```

## ONE_DRIVE_SEARCH_ITEMS
Search OneDrive for files and folders by keyword. Searches filenames, metadata, and file content to find matching items. Use when you need to find specific files based on keywords, file types, or content. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination. Results are mixed files and folders — filter client-side using file vs folder properties. Disambiguate similarly named items using parentReference.path, lastModifiedDateTime, and size before passing item IDs downstream. Newly created or recently moved files may not appear due to indexing delays; fall back to ONE_DRIVE_LIST_FOLDER_CHILDREN if expected items are missing. No server-side date filtering — apply lastModifiedDateTime/createdDateTime filtering in your own logic. HTTP 429 responses include a Retry-After header; use exponential backoff.

## ONE_DRIVE_UNFOLLOW_ITEM

## ONE_DRIVE_UPDATE_DRIVE_ITEM_METADATA
Tool to update the metadata of a specific item (file or folder) in OneDrive. Use this to rename items, change descriptions, or move items to a new parent folder.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateDriveItemMetadataRequest",
  "required": [
    "item_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "new-file-name.docx"
      ],
      "description": "The new name for the drive item. Must not contain illegal characters: `\\`, `/`, `:`, `*`, `?`, `'`, `<`, `>`, `|`; these trigger an `invalidRequest` error.",
      "human_parameter_name": "New Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "What you want to rename the file or folder to. Enter the full new name, including the extension for files."
    },
    "ifMatch": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "If Match",
      "examples": [
        "\"{99F4367E-7299-4600-A8A0-3F158F4E9D6B},2\"",
        "\"c:{99F4367E-7299-4600-A8A0-3F158F4E9D6B},1\""
      ],
      "description": "The eTag or cTag value for conditional update. If this header is included and the eTag provided doesn't match the current eTag on the item, a 412 Precondition Failed response is returned. Use this to prevent conflicts when multiple users update the same item.",
      "human_parameter_name": "If-Match ETag",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide the current eTag of the item to ensure you're updating the latest version. This prevents accidental overwrites when multiple people are editing. Leave blank to skip this check."
    },
    "item_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Item Id",
      "examples": [
        "01NKDM7HMOJTVYMDOSXFDK2QJDXCDI3WUK"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the drive item (file or folder) to update.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Item ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the file or folder you want to update. You can copy this from a previous search/list result or from the item\u2019s URL in OneDrive."
    },
    "site_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Site Id",
      "examples": [
        "contoso.sharepoint.com,024d491a-4d09-4194-ae1f-7413535507dc,024d491a-4d09-4194-ae1f-7413535507dc"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the site. Used when updating an item within a site's drive.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Site ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "If the item is stored in a SharePoint site\u2019s drive, enter that site\u2019s ID. Use this when targeting a site instead of a user, group, or specific drive."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "024d491a-4d09-4194-ae1f-7413535507dc"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the user. Used when updating an item within a specific user's drive.",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "If the item belongs to a specific user\u2019s OneDrive, enter that user\u2019s ID (or use 'me' for your own). Use this instead of Group ID, Site ID, or Drive ID."
    },
    "drive_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Drive Id",
      "examples": [
        "b!C3NkF4b2GU2msLpLqgZ4oYd_S4P0S6_FhG0bS-WpTkYwGVc_FmBYSZ7d0x_ZJpG-"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the drive. Required if not using other specific paths like /me, /groups/{group-id}, /sites/{site-id}, or /users/{user-id}.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Drive ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide this if the item is in a specific drive you want to target. Leave it blank if you\u2019re using your own drive or selecting a group, site, or user instead."
    },
    "group_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group Id",
      "examples": [
        "024d491a-4d09-4194-ae1f-7413535507dc"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the group. Used when updating an item within a group's drive.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Group ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "If the file or folder is in a Microsoft 365 group\u2019s drive, enter that group\u2019s ID. Use this instead of Drive ID, Site ID, or User ID."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "examples": [
        "Updated project proposal document."
      ],
      "description": "The new description for the drive item.",
      "human_parameter_name": "New Description",
      "human_parameter_description": "A short summary or notes about the item to help others understand it. Leave blank to keep the current description."
    },
    "fileSystemInfo": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileSystemInfo",
      "examples": [

          "createdDateTime": "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z",

        }
      ],
      "properties": {
        "createdDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Created Date Time",
          "format": "date-time",

          ],

        "lastAccessedDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Last Accessed Date Time",
          "format": "date-time",
          "examples": [
            "2023-01-21T08:00:00Z"
          ],
          "description": "The UTC date and time the file was last accessed. ISO 8601 format."
        },
        "lastModifiedDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Last Modified Date Time",
          "format": "date-time",
          "examples": [
            "2023-01-20T15:45:00Z"
          ],
          "description": "The UTC date and time the file was last modified on a client. ISO 8601 format."
        }
      },
      "description": "File system information on client.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "human_parameter_name": "File System Info",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set client-side file system timestamps. Useful for preserving original file creation and modification dates when syncing files from a local device."
    },
    "parent_reference_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent Reference Id",
      "examples": [
        "01NKDM7HMOJTVYMDOSXFDK2QJDXCDI3WUK"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the new parent item. Use this to move the item. The driveId of the parentReference can also be specified if moving between drives. For cross-drive moves, `parent_reference_drive_id` is required alongside this field. Omit both fields when only renaming or updating metadata to avoid unintended moves.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Parent Item ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The destination folder\u2019s item ID if you want to move this file or folder. Combine with Parent Drive ID if moving to a different drive."
    },
    "parent_reference_drive_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Parent Reference Drive Id",
      "examples": [
        "b!C3NkF4b2GU2msLpLqgZ4oYd_S4P0S6_FhG0bS-WpTkYwGVc_FmBYSZ7d0x_ZJpG-"
      ],
      "description": "The drive ID of the new parent item, if moving to a different drive.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Parent Drive ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Only needed if you\u2019re moving the item to a different drive. Enter the ID of the drive where the destination folder lives."
    }
  }
}
```

## ONE_DRIVE_UPDATE_DRIVE_ITEMS_PERMISSIONS
Tool to update the roles of an existing permission on a OneDrive drive item. Use when you need to change the access level (read, write, owner) for a specific permission on a file or folder.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateDriveItemsPermissionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "item_id",
    "permission_id",
    "roles"
  ],
  "properties": {

      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "enum": [
          "read",
          "write",
          "owner"
        ],

        "description": "Valid permission roles for OneDrive items."

      "title": "Roles",
      "examples": [
        [
          "write"

        [
          "read"
        ]

      "description": "The unique identifier of the drive item."
    },
    "site_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Site Id",
      "examples": [
        "contoso.sharepoint.com,2C712604-1397-42ED-85C7-5843590F0202,2D22A158-83D2-4D48-92C1-502810230D0A"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of a SharePoint site. Use this if the item is in a SharePoint site's drive."

    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "024d426a-2f0f-4e9a-92c1-502810230d0a"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of a user. Use this if the item is in a specific user's drive (other than 'me')."
    },

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Drive Id",
      "examples": [
        "b!C1234567890ABCDEFGH"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the drive. Required if not using other identifiers like group_id, site_id, or user_id."
    },
    "group_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group Id",
      "examples": [
        "024d426a-2f0f-4e9a-92c1-502810230d0a"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of a group. Use this if the item is in a group's drive."
    },
    "permission_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Permission Id",
      "examples": [
        "aTowIy5mfG1lbWJlcnNoaXB8a2FyYW52YWlkeWFAYXV0aGtpdC5haQ"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the permission to update."
    }
  }
}
```

## ONE_DRIVE_UPDATE_FILE_CONTENT
Tool to create an upload session for updating an existing file's content in OneDrive. Use when you need to overwrite/update an existing DriveItem's content while preserving its item ID, avoiding duplicate copies and maintaining existing share links.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateFileContentRequest",
  "required": [
    "item_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "document.pdf",
        "report.xlsx"
      ],
      "description": "The name of the item (filename and extension). Use this to override the filename during the upload session."
    },
    "item_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Item Id",
      "examples": [
        "01NKDM7HMOJTVYMDOSXFDK2QJDXCDI3WUK"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the DriveItem (file) to update."
    },
    "site_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Site Id",
      "examples": [
        "contoso.sharepoint.com,024d491a-4d09-4194-ae1f-7413535507dc,024d491a-4d09-4194-ae1f-7413535507dc"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the SharePoint site. If provided, uses /sites/{siteId}/drive. Mutually exclusive with drive_id, group_id, and user_id."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "024d491a-4d09-4194-ae1f-7413535507dc"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the user. If provided, uses /users/{userId}/drive. Mutually exclusive with drive_id, site_id, and group_id."
    },
    "drive_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Drive Id",
      "examples": [
        "b!C3NkF4b2GU2msLpLqgZ4oYd_S4P0S6_FhG0bS-WpTkYwGVc_FmBYSZ7d0x_ZJpG-"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the drive. If not provided, uses /me/drive. Mutually exclusive with site_id, group_id, and user_id."
    },
    "group_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group Id",
      "examples": [
        "024d491a-4d09-4194-ae1f-7413535507dc"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the group. If provided, uses /groups/{groupId}/drive. Mutually exclusive with drive_id, site_id, and user_id."
    },
    "file_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "File Size",
      "examples": [
        1048576,
        5242880
      ],
      "description": "Provides an expected file size to perform a quota check before uploading. Only supported on OneDrive Personal."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "examples": [
        "Project proposal for Q1 2024"
      ],
      "description": "Provides a user-visible description of the item. Only supported on OneDrive Personal."
    },
    "defer_commit": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Defer Commit",
      "description": "If true, the file creation is deferred until an explicit completion request is made. Useful for very large files where you want to control when the upload is finalized."
    },
    "media_source": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "MediaSource",
      "properties": {
        "contentCategory": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content Category",
          "description": "Enumeration value that indicates the media content category."
        }
      },
      "description": "Media source information. Only on OneDrive for Business and SharePoint.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "if_match_etag": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "If Match Etag",
      "examples": [
        "aQzlGRDlBMjdBRDQ5RUVCOTE3LjA"
      ],
      "description": "An ETag value to prevent lost updates. If provided, the update will only proceed if the current file's ETag matches this value. Returns 412 error if it doesn't match."
    },
    "file_system_info": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileSystemInfo",
      "properties": {
        "createdDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Created Date Time",
          "format": "date-time",
          "examples": [
            "2023-01-15T10:30:00Z"
          ],
          "description": "The UTC date and time the file was created on a client. ISO 8601 format."
        },
        "lastAccessedDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Last Accessed Date Time",
          "format": "date-time",
          "examples": [
            "2023-01-21T08:00:00Z"
          ],
          "description": "The UTC date and time the file was last accessed. ISO 8601 format."
        },
        "lastModifiedDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Last Modified Date Time",
          "format": "date-time",
          "examples": [
            "2023-01-20T15:45:00Z"
          ],
          "description": "The UTC date and time the file was last modified on a client. ISO 8601 format."
        }
      },
      "description": "File system information on client.",
```
